# nlohmann/json 3.11.3

Unmodified MIT-licensed single header, vendored for offline C++11 M1 builds.
It is a private dependency of `semantic_plan_prompt` and its unit tests. It is
not taken from DuckDB, exposed in the public M1 headers, or linked into the M0
extension. No network access is needed at configure, build or test time.

Upstream files (tag `v3.11.3`):

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.11.3/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.11.3/LICENSE.MIT
